hypothesis: After a raw excerpt reaches the reranker, scoring its exact numbered sentences and exposing at most two TAKE sentences as citable evidence will preserve the five useful answers while preventing neighboring but question-irrelevant ideas from entering the evidence shelf.
private_input: The same eight already opened cases and the same frozen raw source bundles used by checkpoint 7S.2.
procedure: Keep the question and frozen raw source bundle unchanged.
Split each raw source deterministically into exact numbered sentences; do not ask a language model to rewrite them.
Score question versus every exact sentence with the same pinned Qwen3-Reranker-4B and frozen thresholds.
Allow at most the two highest-scoring TAKE sentences from each raw source. NOT_SURE and DROP sentences are context only and cannot be cited.
Let Qwen3-8B read the whole forwarded source for context but require every extracted claim to cite only an allowed sentence ID.
Reject invented or non-allowed IDs with ordinary code.
Run DeBERTa on the exact allowed sentence versus the extracted claim.
Let the writer see only DeBERTa-entailing claims and their exact evidence.
Review all eight final answers manually.

models.sentence_relevance: Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-4B Q4_K_M, same revision and hash as 7S.2

privacy: Raw questions, excerpts, sentence scores, model outputs and per-case answers remain owner-private. Only aggregate counts, failures and the decision may be published.
claim_boundary: Outcome-conditioned development replay. It tests fine-grained evidence selection inside frozen source bundles, not retrieval recall, unseen generalization, a packaged app or physical devices.
